en.headline: HAVF home audio-visual festival opens tomorrow at Kowloon Tong InnoCentre
en.dek: The free two-day event features LG, Sony and other brands demonstrating televisions, soundbars and home cinema systems from 6 to 7 November.
body: The Home Audio and Visual Festival 2026, or HAVF, opens tomorrow at InnoCentre in Kowloon Tong and runs through Saturday, organisers said.

Organised by the review channel AV Eric and the platform GadgetGang, the event focuses on home entertainment equipment. Large demonstration areas will show products from LG and Sony, including various display technologies for televisions and projectors, while dedicated rooms will present systems from brands such as Bose, KEF and Cambridge.

Opening hours are 10am to 7pm on Friday and 10am to 6pm on Saturday. Admission is free, though visitors need to complete a registration form in advance or on site. The venue is a short walk from Kowloon Tong MTR station.
The festival also includes open display areas for headphones and personal audio products from multiple local and international exhibitors.

zh.headline: HAVF視聽娛樂祭明起於九龍塘創新中心舉行
zh.dek: 為期兩日的免費活動將於11月6日至7日舉行，現場有LG、Sony等品牌示範電視、Soundbar及家庭影院系統。
body: 主辦單位表示，「HAVF視聽娛樂祭2026」明日在九龍塘創新中心開幕，至周六結束。
活動由影音評測頻道AV Eric與GadgetGang合辦，聚焦家庭娛樂設備。大型示範區將展示LG及Sony的產品，包括不同顯示技術的電視及投影機，另設專用房間示範Bose、KEF及Cambridge等品牌的系統。
開放時間為周五上午10時至晚上7時，周六上午10時至晚上6時。入場免費，但參觀者需預先或即場填寫登記表。場地距離港鐵九龍塘站步行約數分鐘。
活動亦設有開放式展銷區，展出多間本地及國際參展商的耳機及個人音響產品。
